an10.72:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ
an10.72:1.2: āyasmatā ca pālena āyasmatā ca upapālena āyasmatā ca kakkaṭena āyasmatā ca kaḷimbhena āyasmatā ca nikaṭena āyasmatā ca kaṭissahena
an10.72:1.3: aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.
an10.72:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi paramparāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.72:2.3: ime kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi paramparāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
an10.72:2.4: saddakaṇṭakā kho pana jhānā vuttā bhagavatā
an10.72:2.6: tattha mayaṃ appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsu vihareyyāmāti
an10.72:2.7: athakho te āyasmanto yena gosiṃgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
an10.72:2.8: tattha te āyasmanto appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsu viharanti.
an10.72:3.2: kahaṃ nu kho bhikkhave pālo kahaṃ upapālo kahaṃ kakkaṭo kahaṃ kaḷimbho kahaṃ nikaṭo kahaṃ kaṭissaho
an10.72:3.3: kahaṃ nu kho te bhikkhave therā sāvakā gatāti.
an10.72:4.2: ime kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā licchavī bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi paramparāya uccāsaddā mahāsaddā mahāvanaṃ ajjhogāhanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya saddakaṇṭakā kho jhānā vuttā bhagavatā yannūna mayaṃ yena gosiṃgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkameyyāma tattha mayaṃ appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsu vihareyyāmāti
an10.72:4.3: athakho te bhante āyasmanto yena gosiṃgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
an10.72:4.4: tattha te āyasmanto appasaddā appakiṇṇā phāsu viharantīti.
an10.72:5.1: sādhu sādhu bhikkhave yathā te mahāsāvakā sammā byākaramānā byākareyyuṃ saddakaṇṭakā hi bhikkhave jhānā vuttā mayā
an10.72:6.3: pavivekārāmassa saṃgaṇikārāmatā kaṇṭako asubhanimittānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa subhanimittānuyogo kaṇṭako indriyesu guttadvārassa visūkadassanaṃ kaṇṭako brahmacariyassa mātugāmupacāro kaṇṭako paṭhamassa jhānassa saddo kaṇṭako dutiyassa jhānassa vitakkavicārā kaṇṭakā tatiyassa jhānassa pīti kaṇṭakā catutthassa jhānassa assāsapassāsā kaṇṭakā saññāvedayitanirodhamāpattiyā saññā ca vedanā ca kaṇṭakā rāgo kaṇṭako doso kaṇṭako
